usage: The word 伯伯 (baak3 baak3) refers specifically to your father's older brother.
It is used to address or mention an uncle who is elder than your father.
In Cantonese, family terms are very specific to age and relation, and 伯伯 is not used for younger brothers or cousins.
You often use 伯伯 when talking about or to your father's elder brother respectfully.
It can also be part of compound phrases when describing family members on the paternal side.
